reason: dsh-pilot is a browser automation plugin for agents, providing accessibility-ref-based page interaction, navigation, waiting, screenshots, uploads, and origin-aware request enforcement.

summaries.zh: 面向智能体的浏览器自动化插件，可通过无障碍引用执行页面导航、交互、等待、截图和文件上传。
summaries.en: A browser automation plugin for agents that uses accessibility references to navigate pages, interact with elements, wait for conditions, capture screenshots, and upload files.

capabilities: Automates browser navigation and tab control
Performs clicks, typing, selection, key presses, uploads, waits, screenshots, and tab closure
Enforces origin permissions through browser request interception
Can use persistent browser profiles and download files when configured
